prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in an established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, hair, beard, expression, pose and clothing reference, Vova Rykhva. Image 2 supplies ONLY the established gouache/colored-pencil medium, actual feline anatomy, bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's gray swept-back hair, sideways pose, smile or light polo shirt.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve the short dark-brown almost black hair with closely faded sides and neat short textured top swept slightly sideways; strong straight thick dark eyebrows, brown/hazel eyes and original spacing, broad oval face, defined angular jaw, calm serious neutral direct gaze and relaxed closed lips. Preserve his prominent full neatly trimmed dark beard and connected moustache as dense darker feline fur around the short muzzle, jaw and chin, retaining its clean rounded lower beard outline. This must be a real feline face with a small natural cat nose, short natural feline muzzle and fine whiskers, not a human face with cat ears attached. Warm muted brown/taupe fur with restrained cream highlights, hair and beard distinctly dark. No gray hair, broad grin or exaggerated cartoon eyes.
Anatomy: exactly TWO pointed CAT ears total, both on TOP of the head, fully inside the frame with ample margin above them. The SIDES of the head at eye level have uninterrupted close fur/hair, no human ears, no side ears, no fleshy lobes.
Clothing: fully clothed black/dark navy button-up collared shirt, top button open, crisp folded collar, relaxed broad upper shoulders. No logos or lettering.
Style: detailed hand-painted warm gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur and fabric, imperfect warm brown contours, ivory highlights; consistent with the portrait series.
Composition: square canvas, one centered contained head-and-upper-torso bust, fully frontal symmetrical pose and direct gaze matching image 1, head and ears fully inside the frame with generous transparent margins, naturally rounded shoulder silhouette at bottom. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove room, walls and background completely. No scenery, other people, props, circle, frame, text or watermark.
